programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 高冷孤僻的企業繼承人顧榮儼然是個“傲嬌公子”，而看似軟萌文靜的少女蘇靜靜實則武藝不凡。一場意外讓“元氣少女”蘇靜靜與“不食人間煙火”的顧榮產生交集，還成為他的貼身保鏢。性格、習慣大相徑庭的兩人不得不開啟室友生活，在追求人生目標中攜手蛻變與成長……

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: E23
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: E4 - Roller Coaster Accidents
programme.desc: High-speed loops, dizzying drops, and the rush of adrenaline—roller coasters are feats of physics and design. But when safety systems fail, lives hang in the balance. In this episode, Fatal Engineering explores some of the most chilling roller coaster accidents in history, analyzing how minute mechanical failures, operator mistakes, and ignored warning signs led to serious injuries and death. Discover what these tragedies taught us about engineering safety and the balance between thrill and risk.

programme.title: E3 - Rivers
programme.desc: Trace dazzling waterways all over the world, from volcanic rivers in Russia’s far east to geothermal streams in Florida. Watch as beavers transform entire landscapes with their well-engineered dams, then enjoy a winter spa day with manatees.

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: The Roundup
programme.desc: 4 years after the events of Garibong district round up operation, Geumcheon Police's Major Crimes Unit is given a mission to repatriate a fugitive who fled to Vietnam. Beast cop Ma Seok-do and Capt. Jeon Il-man intuitively realize that there's something wrong with the suspect's willingness to turn himself in and uncover crimes committed by a terrifying killer named Kang Hae-sang. Ma and his unit begin their investigation across two countries and follow the bloody breadcrumbs left behind by Kang...

programme.title: Christmas Rose
programme.desc: Tim is a defence attorney with a heart of gold. Refusing to be simply a hired gun for his clients, he quits his high-powered job to become a prosecutor for the Justice Department. With the support of fiancee Megan and cop buddy Nam, Tim decides to start afresh. When he meets a handicapped piano teacher, Jing, who urges him to help her. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. As a media frenzy encircles the case, it slowly destroys the lives of everyone involved.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -UFO Files: Behind the Madness
programme.desc: Filmed in just eleven days, the low-budget production “Unidentified Murder” saw a massive burst of creativity from both the cast and crew; the actors' improvisations kept the set filled with laughter. In this Interview, the creative team is invited to share their production process and reveal the chaotic, unpredictable moments the crew experienced while filming up on the hill.

programme.title: Kapuso Mo Jessica Soho
programme.desc: Features the lighter side of veteran journalist, Jessica Soho, and highlights insightful stories of a wide range of topics

programme.title: Amazing Earth
programme.desc: An infotainment show exploring the Philippines, featuring its natural formations, diverse terrains, and fascinating flora and fauna.

programme.title: GMA Pinoy Blockbuster: 'Manila Kingpin: The Asiong Salonga Story'
programme.desc: A biopic of the notorious late-1940s Manila gangster until his death at 26 in 1951: a legend known to this day who came from Tondo.

programme.title: You're My Favorite Song
programme.desc: Angel, a brilliant young girl, races to fulfill her dying grandfather's bucket list-starting with building a resort on their beachfront land. To succeed, she must outsmart powerful moguls trying to seize the property while enlisting her classmates' help to run the business in exchange for tutoring.

programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活。

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E12 -Let's Eat Healthy Food!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers explore everything about healthy food: where it comes from, where we can buy it, trying new foods, and how it helps us get energy, stay healthy, and grow strong!

programme.title: E1 - A Fun School Day with JJ & Friends!
programme.desc: Join JJ & his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks & drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses & how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day & enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning & fun!

programme.title: E4 - Blocks, Dancing, Football & Storytime!
programme.desc: It's a day of learning to play together with blocks, dancing, football & storytime! First, Jeff's neat block towers keep getting knocked over by Bubbles, & they must learn to share their space. Then, Fuse refuses to listen to instructions during a dancing game & has to learn how to work as a team. The lessons continue as Bubbles learns not to cheat to win a football game & Jeff has to decide if he will share his new book during storytime.

programme.title: E6 - Calm Songs & Sweet Dreams!
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some fun adventures & sleepy songs! First, help Twinkle find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck & cow make along the way! Then, Bunny leads Twinkle on an exciting adventure into the forest to find a mysterious box. After a long day of playing, it's time for some sleepy songs. Listen as Mr. Moon sings a soothing lullaby to help Twinkle drift off to sleep for a peaceful night's rest.

programme.title: E2 - Construction Chaos & Clever Fixes
